Microgravity evidence.
Exploration insight.

Turning decades of combustion research into inspectable fire-safety trade studies for Moon and Mars habitats.

PyroZero v2.6 · Engineered by Zentrix Labs, R&D division of Zentrix Edge
2026 NASA International Space Apps Challenge · Independent research prototype
notes: Open with the research question: does a material behave the same way when gravity, ventilation, and oxygen change? PyroZero makes the evidence and assumptions inspectable. This is not operational flight approval.

title: The lunar fire trap
html:
The lunar fire trap

Earth-test behavior can change in a reduced-gravity, oxygen-enriched environment.

34% O₂

At 8.2 psia / 56.5 kPa.
About 62% higher oxygen fraction than 21% air.

0.165g

Enough buoyant flow to replenish oxygen, with less convective heat loss.

70%

Of subsystems assessed in one NASA ECLSS study require material replacement.

The research bottleneck

Terabytes of PSI research must be matched to fuel, atmosphere, flow, and scale. Partial-gravity coverage remains sparse; simulated-lunar LUCI evidence already exists.

NASA NTRS 20260003925; 20240015307; NASA PSI update (July 2025); LUCI flight summary. Some cool-flame regimes in the supplied records are near 800 K; flame appearance alone is not a safety test.
notes: The 70% finding is limited to assessed ECLSS subsystems. The brief’s 12 TB figure is not independently established; NASA reported about 30 TB across the wider PSI archive in July 2025. Do not claim zero lunar-gravity experiments: LUCI has simulated-lunar results. Atmospheric oxygen fraction and oxygen partial pressure are different quantities.

title: Bridging the partial-gravity gap
html:
Bridging the partial-gravity gap

Change a condition. Inspect the modeled boundary. See where evidence is still missing.

Uₘ = √(V²forced + V²buoyant)

Track Gr, Reeff, Da and an E-FIELD ion-drag equivalent geff.

NOMS = max(0, LOC₁g − LOCmission)

1.54 oxygen percentage points
Modeled lunar PMMA example: 0.165g, 56.5 kPa, 34% O₂, 10 cm/s, zero field.

The supplied quench and blowoff closures form a check-mark LOC boundary.

A transparent surrogate helps prioritize questions.
Qualification still requires representative physical tests.

Inputs, constants, and outputs: src/lib/pyrozero-engine.ts and docs/submission-benchmarks.json. E-FIELD analogy is a supplied engineering closure, not measured replacement gravity.
notes: NOMS is the difference between modeled LOC values, not ambient O2 minus LOC. It varies with material and conditions; the brief’s 1.4–2.7 range is not universal. Electric body-force mapping is an equivalent-flow comparison. The model does not reconstruct all direction, geometry, or chemistry effects of a real partial-gravity experiment.

title: Space lessons, Earth applications
html:
Space lessons, Earth applications

Apollo 1 · Apollo 13 · Mir

Trace discrete report anchors, fuel context, containment, ignition, and detection lessons.

Artemis II appears separately as an annotated smoke-alarm case. It is not treated as a confirmed spacecraft fire.

Fine water mist

Supplied D₁₀ = 28 μm and D₃₂ = 46 μm references. Explore surface area and droplet diameter.

Potential: compact suppression systems.
650 nm particle optics

Polarization and multiple scattering angles help explain dust, smoke, and mist discrimination.

Potential: demanding industrial environments.
4,500 psi composite SCBA

Compare stored air with legacy cylinders; distinguish PBI turnout fabrics from Beta cloth.

Potential: firefighter protection research.

Demonstrations and potential applications—not CFD, certified detectors, fire-extinguisher approval, or SCBA service-duration guarantees. Li-ion/data-center and mine use require dedicated testing.
notes: Avoid claiming all technologies were directly caused by each accident. The workbench compares engineering principles and source context. Water-mist moments do not uniquely define a droplet distribution. Optical depolarization examples are not a calibrated classifier. Ideal free-air estimates do not determine actual breathing duration. New terrestrial products and commercialization are future research, not completed deployments.

Zentrix Labs · Research prototype. Potential audiences include agency and commercial habitat teams; no NASA, SpaceX, or Blue Origin customer relationship is claimed.
notes: Software verification means equation conformance, bounds, API behavior, and UI function—not independent physical validation. This release adds 7 expiry tests to the prior 138. Shared demo access has a fixed server deadline, after which visitors can use their own DeepSeek key. Future hosted service scaling needs authentication, quotas, observability, and independent scientific review; do not present it as an existing enterprise SaaS capability.
